items.title: George "Kid Sheik" Colar Interview, 1959-01-20
items.q: That was the time of Claude Gable suits come out.

ctx.x: Made with thread? Sort of decorated with thread or something else sewed on them? How are you?

No, they're just arrows. Just put around this. You know, just one arrow here and one arrow. That was the time of Claude Gable suits come out. Well, they called them the Sheik. They used to have uptown pockets. You see, your pants was made like this, the pockets. They were a little more around in front. Yeah, like that. And they open on the top. Yeah. And I'm dropping that thing. Straight down. Uptown pockets, they call them. When were you born? I was born September 15, 1908. Where were you born? I was born on…
Oh, good. Maroney and Johnson. Any of your family musicals?
